mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, payment_method, payment_time, delivery_time, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{order_no}, #{user_id}, #{total_amount}, #{pay_amount}, #{status}, #{payment_method}, #{payment_time}, #{delivery_time}, #{receiver_name}, #{receiver_phone}, #{receiver_address}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
